name: Comic Documentary
description: Detailed 2D hand-drawn comic book animation with documentary narration — vintage graphic novel style, 9:16 vertical
image_style: detailed 2D hand-drawn comic book illustration, semi-realistic characters, expressive faces, clean ink outlines, sketch-like cross-hatch shading, muted earthy tones, warm beige and brown palette, olive green accents, gray shadows, vintage illustrated graphic novel appearance, detailed atmospheric background, cinematic composition, high quality digital ink art
negative_prompt: photo, photorealistic, 3D render, CGI, bright saturated colors, neon, anime, chibi, cartoon flat colors, blurry, low quality, text, watermark, logo, modern digital clean look
script_system_prompt: You write scripts for short documentary-style animated videos with a vintage comic book visual style. Your narration is engaging, informative, and cinematic — like a National Geographic documentary crossed with a graphic novel. You always reply with valid JSON only.
script_user_template:
Create a short animated documentary video about "{topic}".

Number of scenes: {scenes}

Rules:
- HOOK FIRST: Scene 1 must open with an attention-grabbing fact, mystery, or bold statement that stops scrolling instantly. No generic intros.
- Voiceover style: Natural English documentary narration. Engaging, conversational, educational. 2-3 sentences per scene (about 15 seconds read aloud).
- Explain the story clearly and build curiosity across scenes.
- Final scene delivers a satisfying conclusion or surprising takeaway.
- image_prompt: Describe the scene as a detailed comic book panel. Include:
  * Camera angle (close-up, wide shot, overhead, low angle, cinematic pan)
  * Character expressions and body language
  * Specific atmospheric details (lighting, setting, time of day)
  * Art direction: ink outlines, earthy tones, sketch shading, graphic novel style
  Example: "Close-up of a weathered explorer's face, wide eyes reflecting firelight, ink outlines, cross-hatch shadows on cheekbones, warm amber tones, detailed cave background with ancient carvings, graphic novel style"
- speaker: use "narrator" for all scenes.
- mood: one of "curious", "tense", "mysterious", "revealing", "triumphant", "emotional"

Reply with JSON in exactly this shape:
{
  "title": "compelling YouTube Shorts title under 70 characters",
  "description": "2-3 sentence description that hooks viewers and teases the topic",
  "tags": ["documentary", "history", "animation", "shorts", "..."],
  "scenes": [
    {"narration": "...", "image_prompt": "...", "speaker": "narrator", "mood": "curious"}
  ]
}
